## UML Testing Profile (UTP) Test Suite for U29_19

**Test Case ID** | **Test Case Title** | **Requirement ID(s)** | **Test Case Type** | **Preconditions** | **Input Data** | **Steps** | **Expected Result**
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
TC-001 | Query Patient Details | VCDPA03 | Positive | Patient with ID exists | Patient ID | 1. Enter Patient ID. 2. Verify patient details are displayed. | Patient details are displayed correctly.
TC-002 | Modify Patient Details | VCDPA03 | Positive | Patient with ID exists | Patient ID, updated details | 1. Enter Patient ID. 2. Modify details. 3. Verify updated details. | Patient details are modified successfully.
TC-003 | Invalid Patient ID | VCDPA03 | Negative | Patient with ID does not exist | Invalid Patient ID | 1. Enter invalid Patient ID. | Error message is displayed.
TC-004 | Appointment Creation | VCDPA04 | Positive | Patient with ID exists | Patient ID, appointment details | 1. Enter Patient ID. 2. Enter appointment details. 3. Verify appointment entry. | Appointment is created for the next day.
TC-005 | Invalid Appointment Date | VCDPA04 | Negative | Patient with ID exists | Patient ID, invalid date | 1. Enter Patient ID. 2. Enter invalid date. | Error message is displayed.
TC-006 | Consultation Request | VCDDR01 | Positive | Consultation request exists | Consultation request | 1. Select consultation request. 2. Provide consultation. | Consultation is provided.
TC-007 | Diagnosis and Prescription | VCDDR02 | Positive | Consultation request exists | Consultation request, diagnosis, medicines | 1. Select consultation request. 2. Enter diagnosis and medicines. 3. Request lab tests (optional). | Diagnosis and prescription are created.
TC-008 | Invalid Diagnosis | VCDDR02 | Negative | Consultation request exists | Consultation request, invalid diagnosis | 1. Select consultation request. 2. Enter invalid diagnosis. | Error message is displayed.
TC-009 | Medicine Dispensing | VCDCM02 | Positive | Prescription exists | Prescription | 1. Select prescription. 2. Dispense medicines. 3. Mark flag. | Medicines are dispensed and flag is marked.
TC-010 | Invalid Medicine Count | VCDCM02 | Negative | Prescription exists | Prescription, invalid medicine count | 1. Select prescription. 2. Enter invalid medicine count. | Error message is displayed.
TC-011 | Lab Test Request | VCDLB02 | Positive | Prescription exists | Prescription, lab tests | 1. Select prescription. 2. Enter lab tests. 3. Mark flag. | Lab tests are added to the prescription and flag is marked.
TC-012 | Invalid Lab Test Count | VCDLB02 | Negative | Prescription exists | Prescription, invalid lab test count | 1. Select prescription. 2. Enter invalid lab test count. | Error message is displayed.
